terrainDescription.zh: 近九成國土覆蓋亞馬遜雨林，人口與農業幾乎全數集中在狹窄的北部沿海平原地帶。
terrainDescription.en: Nearly 90% of the country is Amazon rainforest, with population and agriculture almost entirely concentrated on a narrow northern coastal strip.

historicalContext.zh: 荷蘭語為全南美洲唯一以荷語為官方語言的國家，日常通用語為以英語為基礎的斯拉南通加語；因歷史上引進印度與爪哇契約勞工，境內另有薩爾納米印地語與蘇利南爪哇語等少數族群語言。道路標誌系統明確仿照荷蘭本土的維也納公約式設計（左駕鏡射版本）。
historicalContext.en: Suriname is the only country in South America with Dutch as its sole official language; Sranan Tongo, an English-based creole, serves as the everyday lingua franca. Historical indentured-labor migration from British India and Dutch Java left behind minority languages like Sarnami Hindustani and Surinamese Javanese. Its road-sign system is explicitly modeled on the Netherlands' Vienna-Convention-style design, mirrored for left-hand traffic.
